summary: Revised Architectural Studio Upgrade & Video-to-Digital Twin Plan incorporating Gemini Pro's dependency-ordered recommendations. Establishes the design tokens (Plus Jakarta Sans, Space Grotesk, warm slate/terracotta palette), procedural oak wood plank and plaster materials with zero 404 dependencies, three-point studio lighting, smooth camera presets (Isometric, Top-Down, Eye-Level) with user-override guardrails, persistent 3D canvas mounting across streamlined tabs (3D Room, Furnish & Fit, Measure & Insights, Scan & Upload), interactive video dropzone with sample rooms and frame-extraction progress, real-time SAT collision detection, auto-packing, and metric scale calibration.
